beats.care: Wear a mask near busy roads and sites if you have asthma, and keep water handy since it's still humid.
beats.what: Santacruz hit 34.3°C on Sunday, down from last week's 38.2°C peak. Citywide AQI was 125, with Colaba worst at 165.
beats.why: With the monsoon gone, there's less rain to wash dust and pollution out of the air.

cards.body: Andheri East (162), Bhandup West (158), Deonar (155) and Malad West (151) were close behind, per CPCB data.
cards.caption: AQI at Colaba, the city's worst on Sunday evening

cards.q: Mumbai's AQI of 125 falls in which CPCB band?
cards.why: CPCB's 'moderate' band covers 101–200, which can affect sensitive groups.

cards.q: How's the October air treating you?

cards.body: IMD expects Monday to stay hot and humid with clear skies, around 35°C. Wednesday may bring partly cloudy skies and a spell or two of rain.
cards.title: Rain on the way?

hook: Mumbai's heat eased, so why is *the air getting worse*?

learn.t: On CPCB's scale, an AQI of 101–200 is 'moderate': it can bother people with asthma, lung or heart problems.

watch: IMD expects one or two spells of rain or thundershowers in Mumbai on Wednesday, October 21.
